title: Worker→container transport: DO binding, container class, client with framing — no public route
done_when: wrangler.jsonc declares the containers entry (class_name PlanParseContainer, image ./containers/plan-parse/Dockerfile, max_instances), the PLAN_PARSE durable_objects binding and its new_sqlite_classes migration, and NO route/service/hostname reaches the container (design §3.1 — this is a security constraint, assert it: a test greps wrangler.jsonc for the class and fails if any routes/services entry references it); worker/lib/drawing/planParseContainer.ts extends Container from @cloudflare/containers (defaultPort 8080, sleepAfter set) and is exported from worker/index.ts; Env gains PLAN_PARSE; containerClient.ts exposes pure encodeCropRequest (JSON header line + newline + PDF bytes — the framing server.mjs:49 parses), pure decodeCropResponse (base64 → bytes, echoed ids matched against the SENT set and unknown ids rejected, failure reasons narrowed to the enum), and callPlanParse using getContainer with instance key `${projectId}:${sourceGeneration}` (§3.1 affinity); encode/decode round-trip, id-mismatch rejection, and the MIN_CROP_WIDTH_PX equality assertion between worker/lib/drawing/crop.ts and containers/plan-parse/render.mjs are covered in scripts/tests/drawing.test.mjs; typecheck:gate green.

title: The two vision skills: Pass A elevation inventory + per-opening composition read, decline first-class
done_when: drawingRead.ts defines two Skill objects following the shape of worker/lib/estimator/skills/plan.ts (buildPrompt with imageDataUrl image_url parts, JSON schema, validate clamp, promptVersion): elevationInventory takes one elevation image and returns window-like objects (normalised TOP-LEFT region per worker/lib/drawing/types.ts:Region, width:height proportion, panel count, per-panel symbol present/absent) and is never asked to name or match anything; openingComposition takes one opening crop plus the schedule row (tag, W×H, type text) and returns divisionAxis, ordered units of {operable: boolean, ratio} summing to ~1, optional printed widthMm ONLY when the sheet dimensions the unit (output spec §1.2 — never back-calculated), and a first-class {unreadable: true, reason} decline; validators refuse a unit carrying a family name (design §5: the drawing claims operable-or-not, never a family), refuse ratios outside 0..1 or not summing within tolerance, and refuse a region with inverted corners; all validator paths (accept, decline, family-smuggling, bad ratios, inverted region) covered pure in scripts/tests/drawing.test.mjs.

title: Pass B assignment and verification checks 1+3 — pure, the not-read rules exactly as designed
done_when: assign.ts implements design §4.2: three signals (tag→wall→elevation, drawn-vs-stated proportion, order along the wall), a row two signals disagree about is not_read, a box two rows both fit makes BOTH rows not_read (the W14/W16 case — pinned by a test reproducing one 2050×2000 box against two rows), and same-size pairs resolve only via order (W5/W6, W9/W11 fixtures); verifyReading.ts implements release-gate checks 1 and 3: schedule cross-check (panel count + operable/passive pattern vs type text — FIXED with a symbol disagrees, OFFSET AWNING with two panels and one symbol agrees) and dimension agreement per output spec §2.2, each returning a surfaced disagreement record, never a resolution; not_stated and not_read remain distinct states end to end (output spec §4); both modules exported via worker/lib/drawing/index.ts and covered pure in scripts/tests/drawing.test.mjs.

title: SplitHint source 'drawing': ratio units through proposeSplit, width precedence, pairing comment corrected
done_when: SplitHint.source (worker/lib/estimator/split.ts:144) gains 'drawing' and SplitUnitHint gains optional ratio; proposeSplit consumes ratio units via the output-spec §1.2 rounding rule (round all but the last unit to the step, last takes the remainder — 2050 × 0.634/0.366 → 1300|750 and 2047 → 1300|747, both partitioning exactly, asserted in scripts/tests/estimator-split.test.mjs); toHint.ts turns a verified reading into the hint applying design §6 precedence — a comment-stated unit width beats the measured ratio, partially stated widths stand with the rest scaled to the remainder, and a count conflict between comment and drawing yields a review flag, never arithmetic; operable units take the SCHEDULE's family and passive units are fixed (§5); the stale precedence comment at worker/lib/estimator/pairing.ts:15 is corrected to match output spec §6 (drawings above energy report for shape); all covered in scripts/tests/drawing.test.mjs.

title: The orchestrator and the pipeline seam: read drawings, merge hints above comment/energy, evidence, progress counts, migration 0059
done_when: read.ts orchestrates design §4 (the only new env-touching module): fetch the plan file's bytes from R2 once, derive elevation regions from positioned text, call the container via containerClient (batching by MAX_CROPS_PER_CALL, deferred honoured, an all-gaps batch makes NO container call), run elevationInventory per elevation and openingComposition per assigned opening through runStage (so ai_stage_runs rows, retries and idempotency come free), store each crop PNG at projects/<projectId>/runs/<runId>/crops/<stageRunId>.png with the key in metrics_json (design §7.3 — result_r2_key keeps the JSON archive, asserted), run verifyReading, and report per-opening outcomes read/not_stated/not_read/unlocated plus disagreements; pipeline.ts invokes it after applyPlanContext (~line 700-740) and merges drawing hints ABOVE schedule_comment and energy_report for shape while energy components still attach for thermal targets (extend the guard at ~784; asserted); evidence rows fill page_no/sheet_ref/region_json; migrations/0059 is exactly two additive nullable INTEGER columns on ai_job_claim (drawings_done, drawings_total) with a header comment 'children affected: none — nothing REFERENCES ai_job_claim' and NO change to the progress_stage CHECK (design §10 — a test greps the migration and fails on CREATE TABLE, DROP, or progress_stage); counts are written with the exact token guard WHERE project_id=? AND source_generation=? AND status='processing' AND processing_token=? and the denominator is the real opening count with not_read still advancing it (§7.1, asserted); parse.ts (~371-400) and src/data/api.ts ExtractionRun (~585) expose drawingsDone/drawingsTotal; the customer-facing response and diagnostic carry NO unread/gap information (§7.2, asserted); a not_read opening leaves today's fallback output byte-identical (asserted).

title: Customer progress UI: 'reading opening N of M', successes only
done_when: useProjectDocuments renders 'reading opening N of M' whenever a processing run carries non-null drawingsTotal (whatever progress_stage says — design §7.1 withdrew the new enum value), falls back to today's phase label when counts are absent, and shows nothing about unreads; scripts/tests/web/customer.spec.ts covers both states with stubbed runs (counts present → counter text; counts absent → existing label unchanged).

title: The geometric second opinion: container segments op, frames port, verification check 2
done_when: The container request accepts an optional per-page wantSegments flag; render.mjs/server.mjs return that page's flattened segments (getOperatorList + CTM walk — extraction only, no matching, no judgement, consistent with the container's charter and design §4.4's 128MB rationale) alongside crops, with validate.mjs bounding the addition and verify.mjs exercising it against the fixture; worker/lib/drawing/frames.ts ports the strict+loose frame matchers from scripts/research/plan-geometry/frames.mjs as pure functions over segments (W1's eight verticals and the shared-jamb W14 case reproduced from fixture segments in scripts/tests/drawing.test.mjs); verifyReading gains check 2 — model reading vs geometric decomposition, agreement recorded, disagreement surfaced never resolved — and read.ts requests segments for elevation pages and feeds the check; scripts/research/plan-geometry/measure.mjs still exits zero (the calibration harness is untouched).

title: Ops surface: readings + provenance on the record, crop route staff-gated and audit-logged, abuse cases executed
done_when: GET /api/ops/projects/:id gains the per-opening readings summary (state read/not_stated/not_read/unlocated, checks fired, disagreement details, crop stageRunId) queried WHERE r.project_id = ? through the ai_stage_runs JOIN ai_runs join (design §9.3); new GET /api/ops/ai/crops/:stageRunId streams the PNG with the R2 key read from the row's metrics_json NEVER from the request, gated by the same isStaffUser predicate as existing ops reads (manufacturer partners excluded — customer data) and audit-logged like the ops.ts:2274 staff download; scripts/tests/drawing-evidence-api.test.mjs is created AND wired into package.json (added to test:heavy, plus a test:drawing-api script) and EXECUTES the abuse cases: customer session on both routes denied, manufacturer-partner session denied, staff allowed, unknown stageRunId 404s without an R2 read, audit row written; DrawingReadings.tsx on ProjectRecordPage shows provenance per line (drawing-read vs default split), every unread and every disagreement, and the crop image via the new route (§7.3 — ops sees gaps AND disagreements; the customer surface is asserted unchanged); scripts/tests/web/ops2-record.spec.ts covers the panel rendering an unread, a disagreement, and a crop request.
